spec.name: sprint42_taker_imbalance_majors_valid_params
spec.hypothesis: Sustained extreme taker-buy share on BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT (z>2 of 30m-smoothed imbalance vs a 1-day baseline) precedes positive 15m drift. Prior taker_imbalance specs used param keys the signal does not read, so none scored; this is the first valid scoring.
spec.power_argument: 2 symbols x cap 3/day x ~92 validation days = up to ~550 entries, above the 300 floor if the trigger fires >=2-3/day. 15m sigma ~30bp, SE at n=300 ~1.7bp, min detectable edge at t=2 ~3.5bp; PASS needs net-of-T2 t>=2, i.e. gross >~26-28bp. Criteria can fail under the null: C0 random-entry on the same pipeline must show net ~-26bp.

errors: closed-door terms ['taker_imbalance']: registry says these families are dead at daily frequency; a NEW mechanism must be argued explicitly
